notes.text: Common microSD boards carry an AMS1117-3.3 regulator and a 74LVC125 buffer and are meant for VCC = 5 V; at VCC = 3.3 V the regulator's dropout leaves the card below 3.3 V. Record facts.regulator = '3V3' once confirmed.
On some boards the 74LVC125 keeps MISO driven while CS is high, which disturbs other devices on a shared SPI bus; give the card its own bus or check the board.
